title: jmap-quotas-client: SessionClient quota_get/changes/query/query_changes
description: New crate crate-jmap-quotas-client (extension-client family, mirror jmap-mail-client): JmapQuotasExt::with_quotas_session, SessionClient with quota_get, quota_changes (returns updatedProperties), quota_query, quota_query_changes; USING includes core + quota. Wiremock tests on RFC 9425 §5 request/response examples.
